item.label: Rightward tracking and left-panning exterior shot around a circular exposed-brick building through foreground trees
item.description: The camera tracks steadily rightward along a shaded dirt path while panning slightly left to keep a circular single-storey building (ent_building) centered-left in the frame. The building features a rubble-stone base/plinth, unplastered pale tan/grey bricks laid in an alternating header-and-stretcher pattern with recessed mortar joints, three horizontal decorative bands of reddish-terracotta bricks, arched barred windows with brick arches, a scalloped vaulted roof overhang, and a white conical peaked roof structure at the center. As the camera moves rightward: from 0.0s to 2.0s, two arched windows on the left curve of the wall are clearly visible before a foreground palm trunk passes right-to-left across the frame (1.5s–3.5s), revealing the open arched entrance doorway with three semicircular red steps and two small white wall plaques (ent_plaques) to its left. Between 3.5s and 6.8s, several thick tree trunks pass closely across the foreground, briefly occluding parts of the building. In the background to the right of the building, a man in a grey shirt and dark trousers (ent_person_1) walks away from the doorway area at 2.3s–3.5s, reappears walking leftward/pausing at 5.5s–8.5s, and stands looking toward the building with a second partially occluded person (ent_person_2) visible beside him at 10.5s–12.01s as the camera pans slightly rightward into the trees at the very end (10.5s–12.01s).

However, editorially the continuous tracking shot divides into three distinct visual phases separated by foreground tree obstacles: (1) 0.0s–2.2s, an unobstructed view of the left side of the curved brick wall and two arched windows before a palm trunk crosses the center; (2) 2.2s–7.0s, a transitional tracking phase where a palm trunk and thick dark tree trunks pass across the foreground while the arched entrance doorway is revealed; and (3) 7.0s–10.5s, a clear view of the front arched doorway, windows, and roof framed by palm trees, followed by 10.5s–12.010667s where the camera pans rightward away from the building into the surrounding trees.
